'''Brucce Jo'dee''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was a high-ranking member of the [[Death's Claw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces that sought to acquire the Death's Claw's supply of [[rakghoul serum]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Brucce Jo'dee appears as the final enemy in the staged mission "Serum Conservation" on Taris in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by [[BioWare]].<ref name="TOR" />
